context: Two students discuss a climate-change graph in a news article
purpose: Teach: グラフ/気候/減る/追わ/抜い/役者/曖昧/フェア

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ねえ、このグラフ見て。気候変動の記事に載ってたやつ。
lines.en: Hey, look at this graph. It was in the climate change article.
lines.style: Casual male university student, curious and engaged tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわ、夏の降水量が年々減るって書いてあるね。なんか怖いかも。
lines.en: Whoa, it says summer rainfall decreases year by year. Kind of scary.
lines.style: Teen girl, slightly alarmed, casual youthful speech.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 去年の数字が一昨年を抜いて、過去最低らしいよ。
lines.en: Last year's number passed the year before, apparently a record low.
lines.style: Male university student, factual and informative tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でも記事の説明、ちょっと曖昧じゃない?原因がはっきり書いてない。
lines.en: But the article's explanation is kind of vague, right? The cause isn't clearly written.
lines.style: Teen girl, mildly critical and skeptical tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 確かに。締め切りに追われて書いた感じがする。フェアな報道とは言えないかも。
lines.en: True. It feels like it was written rushed by deadline. Can't really call it fair reporting.
lines.style: University male, thoughtful and analytical critique tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: テレビで有名な役者がこの問題について話してたよ。意外と詳しかった。
lines.en: A famous actor was talking about this issue on TV. Surprisingly knowledgeable.
lines.style: Teen girl, sharing observation with light enthusiasm casually.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、それは見たかったな。俺たちもちゃんと勉強しないとね。
lines.en: Oh, I would've wanted to see that. We should study this properly too.
lines.style: Male university student, reflective and self-motivating tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、レポートにこのグラフ使おうかな。先生にちゃんと説明できるように。
lines.en: Yeah, maybe I'll use this graph in my report. So I can explain it properly to the teacher.
lines.style: Teen girl, determined and planning ahead confidently.
